learnings: beehiiv posts on this publication accept at most ONE 'primary' (with-logo) advertisementOpportunity plus ONE 'secondary' (no-logo) one. Placing two primaries fails with 'No primary ad slot is available in this post'. For 2 real ads use one primary + one secondary; the 3rd AD_SLOT is a placeholder.
